sentences.text:
Jonnala Deepthi , Sai Mounika vs Artham Nagender And
Another on 12 March, 2025
Author: Juvvadi Sridevi

Bench: Juvvadi Sridevi
 Hon'Ble Smt. Justice Juvvadi Sridevi
 Criminal Petition No.552 of 2022
Order:

This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 482 of the Criminal Procedure Code, 1973 (for short 'Cr.P.C.') by the petitioner/accused seeking No.1 to quash the proceedings against her in FIR No.13 of 2022 of Cyber Crime Police Station, Rachakonda, L.B.Nagar registered for the alleged offences punishable under Sections 417, 419, 420 of IPC and section 66(C & D) of Information Technology Act, 2000.

entities.text: Cyber Crime Police Station, Rachakonda, L.B.Nagar
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
2. Heard M/s.K.Sai Babu, learned counsel for the petitioner and Smt. T.Madhavi, learned Assistant Public Prosecutor for respondent No.2 - State.
3.

Though this petition is filed for quashing the proceedings in the crime, during the course of arguments, learned counsel for petitioner has sought for directions to the Police to proceed with investigation by issuing notice under Section 41-A of Cr.P.C. (presently 35(3) of BNSS).
4.

In view of the above, without going into merits of the matter, this criminal petition is disposed of directing the Police concerned to proceed with the investigation in the above crime after issuing notice under Section 41-A of Cr.P.C. (presently 35(3) of BNSS) to the petitioner/accused No.1 and he shall also follow the guidelines of Hon'ble Supreme Court in Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar and another 1 scrupulously.

entities.text: Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: operate with the investigating officer in concluding the investigation.
5. Accordingly, the Criminal Petition is disposed of.
Miscellaneous applications, if any pending, shall also stand closed.
